semantic_description: Total top-line revenue or net sales for the period. Must be the consolidated total, not a segment, product line, or revenue sub-type.
Direct costs attributable to producing goods sold or services rendered. Also reported as cost of goods sold (COGS) or cost of sales.
Revenue minus cost of revenue. The subtotal before operating expenses.
Total operating expenses below gross profit, such as SG&A and R&D. Not the same as total costs — excludes cost of revenue and items below the operating income line.
Income from operations after all operating costs. Excludes interest, taxes, and non-operating items. Also known as EBIT when D&A is not separately broken out.
Cost of debt financing. Net of interest income only if the concept explicitly represents a net figure. Do not map a net interest income concept here.
Total income tax provision for the period, both current and deferred. Must be the consolidated total tax charge.

Bottom-line net income for the entire consolidated entity after all expenses and taxes. Must be the total, not net income attributable to a specific share class, noncontrolling interest subset, or per-share figure.
Cash on hand and short-term liquid instruments. If the concept includes restricted cash or short-term investments beyond cash equivalents, do not map it here.
Net trade receivables from customers, after allowance for doubtful accounts. Excludes notes receivable and non-trade receivables.
Total inventory held for sale or use in production. Must be the consolidated total, not a single inventory component (e.g. raw materials only).
Sum of all assets expected to be converted to cash or used within one year or one operating cycle.
The grand total of all assets on the balance sheet. Must be the highest-level asset aggregate — do not map to a segment or subsidiary total.
Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services received but not yet paid. Excludes accrued liabilities and other payables unless explicitly combined in the concept.
Sum of all liabilities due within one year or one operating cycle.
Total interest-bearing debt, including both short-term borrowings and long-term debt. If no single concept covers both, do not force a mapping — leave as null.
The grand total of all liabilities on the balance sheet. Must be the highest-level liability aggregate.
Total stockholders' or shareholders' equity. Must be the consolidated total including noncontrolling interests if present, not equity attributable to the parent only.
Net cash provided by or used in operating activities. The top-level subtotal of the operating section of the cash flow statement.
Cash paid to acquire or improve property, plant, and equipment. Typically has arcWeight=-1 (cash outflow). Do not include proceeds from asset sales.

Non-cash D&A charge added back as a reconciling item in the operating section of the cash flow statement. Do not map an income statement depreciation line here unless it also appears in cash flow reconciliation.
